ruling.source: Exact Root ruling in this implementation thread

rationale.decision: Root accepts A2FP -> narrowed existing A2F, registered in this same PR. The 374 subtotal includes unqualified cross-fixture calls; activation selection, detached read-only witness, structural CLI validation, falsifiers and lifecycle remain unmeasured. No implementation fit is asserted. If FP overflows, tell Root before any third split proposal.

L1-SMOKE-A2FP: Using frozen A1 harness/transport read-only on a real built production image, provision canonical units/positions, authenticated participants and current spectator seats through ordinary APIs/actions. Prove accepted legal phase-ready Move, Attack and Physical commands, correlated declaration events and durable read-only witnesses; never insert sealed declarations or use source-host calls. Select the active phase unit and matching authenticated principal from actual activation order, preserving a still-eligible second actor able to withhold reveal. Missing legal reachability retains explicit unrun rows and stops for Root; no product seam is granted.

Own the ordinary context, reachability runner and read-only stopped-private-DB phase/unit/declaration witnesses. Validate CLI input structurally and falsify live owning PID, foreign/redirected private DB, unexpected metadata/canonical unit/position/phase/weapon/limb/lock state, missing accepted intent and absent positive/precondition control. Read-only witnesses must leave DB lineage/history unchanged. No trusted brand/stale-assignment mutation is granted to FP.

Freeze import-safe provisioner, activation-aware phase-ready callbacks, accepted-command checks, read-only witnesses and explicit required-case enumeration for F/M/A2. Use installed tsx or standalone SQL offline with the owned server stopped; no new loader/dependency or existing A1/product/helper/config edit. Preserve A1 command/exit/build/listener/readiness/owned-PID/DB hashes, credential redaction and bounded cleanup; tokens never enter URLs or retained evidence. Tests falsify broken guards and missing accepted-action/precondition controls.

FP supplies ordinary provisioning/read-only reachability only. Narrowed F must reuse it read-only, add every trusted audience and observed non-spectating-GM positive, and re-execute the full F acceptance before M admission. FP alone accepts no full privacy matrix, co-op restart, captured rolls, concurrent-first-sockets or B/H/RC gate. Require FP genuine exact-main PASS, fetched-Main ancestry and closure before F admission.
L1-SMOKE-A2F: Import frozen A1/FP modules read-only. Establish current spectator seats for player brand with stale side assignment, GM brand with stale assignment and GM without assignment, using stopped-owned-private-DB fixtures only for unreachable trusted brand/stale/phase preconditions. GM identity must be witnessed by a real durable campaign_session_participant gm row. Preserve trusted metadata and canonical unit/phase preconditions; refuse live owning PID, foreign/redirected DB or unexpected trusted state and retain before/after private-DB lineage with unchanged combat events.

Observe an actual correlated unrevealed authoritative declaration on a separate non-spectating-GM socket, consistently with the one-active-GM-per-session constraint. Qualify fixture-only GM branding against the real built image, including recovery and the durable role source; a label, fabricated transport role or durable row alone is not a positive delivery control. Ordinary accepted intents produce positive behavior, never inserted sealed declaration events or source-host/append/broadcast internals.

Freeze import-safe trusted-audience/mutation callbacks and structural witnesses for M/A2, composing FP ordinary provisioning and activation-aware Move/Attack/Physical reachability with every trusted-condition control in one verified A1 image/private-DB lineage. Keep the second actor able to withhold reveal; re-run all FP required rows, preserve command/exit/build/listener/readiness/PID/DB identity and credential guarantees. Use only installed tsx/standalone SQL offline, with no loader/dependency or existing predecessor/product edits. Falsifiers reject broken guards, missing positive GM/accepted-action/precondition witnesses and omitted inherited rows.

Full F composition retains all four original F acceptance rows across FP and narrowed F; every row remains owed and original text is preserved in registration20261020 and this evidence. F genuine exact-main PASS, fetched-Main ancestry and closure remain required before M admission. F supplies trusted reachability, not the nine-case privacy matrix or co-op restart; M, final A2 and B retain all original A2 acceptance. CF-MPRU2-3 and CF-MPHD-5 stay final A2-owned; no downstream gate is waived.

originalFAcceptance: Using frozen A1 harness/transport read-only on a real built production image, prove legal phase-ready fixtures for accepted Move, Attack and Physical commands. Keep a second actor able to withhold reveal until negative observations finish. Ordinary authenticated APIs/actions provision positive behavior; stopped-DB fixtures only establish unreachable trusted stale-seat/brand/phase preconditions. Never insert sealed declaration events as a substitute for accepted intents. If reachability needs a product seam, retain explicit unrun rows and stop for a separately registered slice.

Witness current spectator seats for player brand with stale assignment, GM brand with stale assignment and GM without assignment; GM identity comes from a real durable campaign-session gm row. Provide a separate non-spectating-GM control consistent with the one-active-GM constraint. Preserve trusted metadata, canonical unit/phase preconditions and before/after private DB lineage; refuse a live owning PID, foreign DB or unexpected trusted state.

Freeze import-safe ordinary provisioner, phase-ready and trusted-audience fixture callbacks plus structural witnesses for A2M/A2. Fixtures use the installed tsx or standalone SQL only while the owned server is stopped. No new dependency/loader or existing A1/source edit. Keep tokens out of URLs and retained evidence, preserve commands/exits/build/listener/readiness/PID/DB hashes, and falsify broken fixture guards and missing accepted-action/precondition controls.

A2F supplies reusable reachability and trusted-condition proof, not acceptance of the nine-case privacy matrix or co-op restart. All original A2 acceptance remains owed through A2M, final A2 composition and B; genuine exact-main PASS and closure are required before A2M admission.

acceptanceCoverage.allocation: FP ordinary accepted M/A/P reachability, activation-aware principal and reveal holder; F composes these with trusted conditions and re-runs all inherited reachability. Explicit unrun rows if product seam needed; no inserted declarations.

FP read-only canonical phase/unit/seat and DB/PID/precondition falsifiers; F all three trusted brands/assignments, real durable GM role, separate observed non-spectating-GM declaration positive and unchanged-history lineage on the actual image.

FP ordinary provisioner/phase-ready/read-only callbacks, strict CLI and positive/guard falsifiers; F trusted-audience callbacks and full F composition. Both preserve all A1 authority, credential, command, image/listener/PID/DB, loader/dependency and offline-only constraints.

FP ordinary-only partial proof; F retains full F acceptance and exact-main closure before M. Full nine-case privacy and co-op restart stay M/final A2/B-owned; every downstream gate and original A2 row stands.
